The more I get the privilege of getting to do stuff I actually really want to do, the more I’m forced to reckon with the fact that procrastination isn’t just about aversion to icky, tedious tasks - it’s also substantially about aversion to failure and disappointment

people usually frame challenging situations in ways that reinforce those challenges https://t.co/gmL1RHgk3C
  [Quoting @visakanv: @Malcolm_Ocean I think of it as like  it doesn’t help solve the problem  and I suspect the problem would be more solvable if it weren’t framed the way it is  same for “incel” too  the problem is not the lack of sex  the narcissist’s problem is not the self-fixation, that’s more of a symptom]
